reasons: Claimed status is compliant and the cited paragraphs (§6(b), §7(c) wind-down, §7(a) liability cap) contain only accrued fees-and-expenses-through-termination obligations, which is an accrued-amounts payment, not a stipulated or liquidated amount payable by Customer.

No early-termination fee, minimum fee, kill fee, penalty or late-payment interest payable by Clear Capital appears in the cited text, so the clause set meets the preferred position (no Customer-payable LDs).
Consistent with the compliant status, no redline was rendered and no comment was raised; the paragraphs are unchanged and deterministic checks are empty.
The rationale correctly parks the §3(b) uncapped rate-change point as a pricing issue for another rule rather than treating it as a liquidated damages deviation, avoiding double-flagging.
